newsitem.title: USA: World Color gives up some pre-earnings gains.
newsitem.headline: World Color gives up some pre-earnings gains.

text.p: Shares of World Color Press Inc eased on Thursday, despite first-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street expectations, with the stock giving up some of its strong gains run up ahead of the release of its results.

Shares of the commercial printing company fell 1-1/2, or more than six percent, to 22-1/2 with volume at about 22,000 shares. The stock had jumped by 2-1/4 on Wednesday, from 21-3/4 to close at 24 on the New York Stock Exchange in fairly heavy volume for the stock.
World Color prints magazines and catalogues.
It posted first quarter earnings per share of $0.20, beating estimates of $0.18 according to First Call, compared with $0.17 a share last year.
A company executive said the printer had held a conference call but in her opinion, had not disclosed any negative news that could materially affect the stock.
